meta.note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on PlayStation Network, taken 18 Nov 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (see sources). Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry; each one names the source its facts come from. Status: verified = a launch-era guide confirms the method; partial = the method follows from the official description or a single source and one detail is still open; unconfirmed = no launch-era source confirms a method yet, and none is invented here.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no shortcut: it is the sum of the story, the 100% checklist and every side trophy in this guide. Keep cheats off the whole run, because PowerPyx reports that a cheat disables both trophies and saving. When this pops, the run is done.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
Keep cheats off your platinum save.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one lands.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission in Chapter 1, and it unlocks as the credits for the mission roll. Nothing to prepare and nothing can be missed here; it is the first trophy most players will earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia before the chapter ends, because that moment is the one possibly missable piece of the whole game (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Finish every Chapter 1 main mission.
Do the balcony meditation with Lucia in Chapter 1 before moving on.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks when Chapter 2 ends, which PowerPyx places at the first mission of Chapter 3. Chapter 2 is also where the dual-character play opens up after Coffee Break, so from here you can switch between Jason and Lucia for the trophies that need both of them.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Finish every Chapter 2 main mission.
From Coffee Break onward, switch characters freely for dual-character trophies.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops once Chapter 3 is complete, after its first two missions of Chapter 4 are done according to PowerPyx. Chapter 3 is where several questlines open: Andy calls Lucia, Randy's wish list begins, and Tyrone's labs appear, so pick those threads up as they arrive.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Finish every Chapter 3 main mission.
Answer Andy's call as Lucia and start Randy's and Tyrone's questlines when they appear.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks when Chapter 4 ends, at the final main mission Starting From Zero. The same mission also closes the story, so this trophy and the gold for the final mission land together.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Finish every Chapter 4 main mission, ending with Starting From Zero.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy and the gold for finishing the game. Complete the final mission, Starting From Zero, and it pops. After the ending you return to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, Stats, so the real cleanup starts here.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete the final mission Starting From Zero.
After the ending, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion to plan the cleanup.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run and it unlocks during the mission. It cannot be missed; just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist and it pops during the mission. It cannot be missed; it is part of the story path.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play and it unlocks during the mission. Story-only, so no preparation is needed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners and it pops during the mission. Like the other mission trophies it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport and it unlocks during the mission. The airport is also the place for the Catch Me If You Can plane stunt later, so learn the layout while you are here.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory and it pops during the mission. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies before the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game and the gold that gates the platinum. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses the requirements are lenient, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, collectibles are only partly needed, and you need 70 of the 80 challenges. The parts that do need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Do 100 optional missions, scan 200 of 277 base vehicle models, study 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, and finish 15 of 18 card sets. Push Square puts the full platinum at up to 300 hours; PowerPyx estimates about 200.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to reveal the checklist under Progress, Stats.
Complete every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest.
Do 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 vehicle scans and 100 animal studies.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. PowerPyx breaks them into 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and you can mix categories freely. Under-bridge flights are the quickest to farm. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, where every stunt has a unique name and stays marked once done. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Open Map, Exploration, Stunt Spots to see stunt locations.
Do 250 stunts in any mix; under-bridge flights are fastest.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. PowerPyx notes the tracker counts nine types and you can check them under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most of them happen naturally while working on other trophies, and the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks their locations, so this is one of the easiest trophies in the set.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, a stunt.
Check Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see which types are still missing.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx links a full location guide for all 12 ranges and all 42 golds. The medals are not brutally hard, and golds here also raise your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy. The 100% checklist needs every shooting range too, so this is not optional work.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit all 12 shooting ranges.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges; repeat a challenge until the gold threshold clears.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). PowerPyx has a location guide for all 14 spots. You only need one win per location, not every race, and the 100% checklist needs all drone races anyway, so fold this into the checklist cleanup.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win at least one race at each location.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so there is plenty of choice: pick the race types you are best at and work through 20 distinct ones. Each race only needs to be won once, and different race locations count separately even if the format repeats.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Pick 20 different race locations from the 40 available.
Win each one once; a win at a new location is what counts.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing also counts toward the Master of None activity types, so this pairs naturally with the rest of the activities stage.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Meet Cal in Feng Shui (Chapter 1).
Wait for Cal's text, follow the purple fishing marker.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of one of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it, so pick the one you find easiest.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Play Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the home TV, or Bang For Your Buck at an arcade machine.
Finish every level of that one game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3: she calls, then texts her home address in Belville, marking the line on the map. Complete her five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and the finale Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse. All of it stays available after the story, so there is no rush, but do it as Lucia.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: As Lucia in Chapter 3, answer Andy's call and go to Belville.
Complete her five quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens in Chapter 1, a while after the Island Dreams mission: he calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks, seven in total, using a metal detector on the ocean floor; turn each set in at his shop and he marks the next ones. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable in later chapters but comes back, so the line is not missable. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: After Island Dreams, answer Kenton's call and go to Key Lento.
Dive all 7 shipwrecks and turn the treasures in at his shop.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and the finale Hometown Heroes. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After Coffee Break, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Billy's five jobs, ending with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying Stranger mission strands. PowerPyx warns that not every optional questline counts: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's McKittrick Farm line, Yago's street-racing mentorship, and Pilot Pete's delivery runs. Track the count in the trophy list itself, and keep playing stranger strands in free-roam until the eighth lands.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Play stranger strands in the open world; Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Check the trophy tracker for the running count.
Finish eight qualifying strands in total.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal a Zorrusso for him with the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 high-end sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City, marked with a green RK icon. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back in good condition for a better payout. Deliveries stay available after the story, and cars he marks appear around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: After Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, take Randy's list of 16 cars.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK, steal the ones on the list, deliver them to Randy's garage.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good, and the trophy pops. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: As Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty, destroy the Synthetic Labs.
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts as two meditations at the same location, and you cannot do the final one until both characters can play together after Coffee Break. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the morning; talk to her in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That meditation becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx is still confirming whether it counts toward the trophy, so do it while you can. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house can only be done in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. PowerPyx is still confirming whether it is required for the trophy, but do it anyway: it is the only possibly missable trophy in the game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1 after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, accept the meditation.
After Coffee Break, meditate at all 18 spots with both characters.
Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and opens after Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. The line has 15 Target Decks, all needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally while doing Bret's quests. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal triggers it, so keep hunting his requests until it pops.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: As Jason after Coffee Break, answer Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals Bret requests and bring them to him.
Work through his 15 Target Decks.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. PowerPyx has a location guide for all 18 sets. You only need three sets for the trophy, but the 100% checklist needs 15 of 18, so treat this as the first milestone of a longer card hunt rather than a one-off.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Find cards in the world and complete any 3 full sets.
Keep collecting toward 15 sets for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app by holding the scan prompt and aiming at the target. PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do. Scan everything you pass while doing other trophies and this fills up on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Use the WAiNK app on landmarks, curiosities and sculptures.
Scan any 100 locations; there are well over 100 available.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy lands on the way there. View and track challenges under Progress, Challenges, and pick the easiest ones first; many complete naturally while working on other trophies. Leave the hardest ones for last, or skip them entirely, since ten more exist than the checklist needs.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open Progress, Challenges to see what is done.
Complete any 50 challenges, easiest first.
Push to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Available from Coffee Break onward, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together: call your partner, then build a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat zone. PowerPyx recommends a fast sports motorcycle and cutting through traffic, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County as an escape route, since the helicopter cannot follow you there. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone. It also tends to unlock on its own during the large bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4-star heat.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner to join you.
Build a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone, for example through the Ambrosia train tunnel.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, call your partner and rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time. PowerPyx advises keeping the flashing wanted level (not the red heat level), wearing an armored vest, and carrying sticky bombs and healing items. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs has unlocked them: loot a couple of items in each, break the safe in the back room, and keep moving. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing the wanted level.
If it does not pop, rob a fourth shop; the unlock is delayed about 30 seconds.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: stand on a busy road and scan every passing vehicle, since scanning is enough and you do not need to drive them. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy lands early on the way to that bigger target. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app on a busy road.
Scan 100 different vehicles; scanning counts, driving is not needed.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill or incapacitate five enemies during one use of Combat Focus, activated while aiming, which slows time and highlights weak spots. It only lasts a few seconds, so prepare first: eat or drink to buff focus, carry Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle. Line up five enemies at a gang operation, then trigger focus and drop them quickly. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Buff focus with food and Adrenaline; wear body armor.
Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation.
Trigger Combat Focus while aiming and take all five down in one use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport, one connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, go up the stairs by the boarding bridge, enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least one kilometre away from the airport and the trophy pops, slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the plane docked at terminal E3/E4.
Board it, enter the cockpit, reverse out and take off.
Fly at least 1 km from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base: drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. PowerPyx documents the tank positions with screenshots, so the hard part is surviving the base, not finding the tank.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in south-west Mariana County.
Enter a Rhino tank in the south of the base.
Shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door, go to the back room, find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe without tripping the alarm. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun.
Find the safe code note, loot the safe, leave undetected.

trophies.guide: Rob any five bank vaults and escape. The line opens with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, grab the cash with your partner's help, and escape the instant 4-star heat on a fast motorcycle. After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each. There are eight large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all eight, so this silver lands on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Complete That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4 to unlock vault robberies.
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani.
Rob 5 vaults and escape the 4-star heat each time.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat radius. The easiest way is the same bank-vault line as Maximum Withdrawal: the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is has you tail an armored truck to a bank, and robbing that vault counts as robbing the truck. You can also do it earlier by blocking an armored truck near a bank, planting a sticky bomb on its back door, and escaping the red heat radius afterwards.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Tail an armored truck to a bank during That's Where The Money Is, or block one on the street.
Break the back door open with a sticky bomb if needed.
Escape the red heat radius.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. It pairs with the WAiNK scanning and vehicle discovery work, since you will be crossing the whole state anyway.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Take a plane and fly over every fogged part of the map.
Keep going until no black fog remains.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you get near them, and the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this trophy lands on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find illegal operations, marked with yellow icons.
Rob at least one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The official description is the clue: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or cafe along Ocean Beach with a view over the water and order a cocktail. PowerPyx still lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, so treat the description as the lead and check back: the exact venue that triggers it has not been confirmed by a full walkthrough yet.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar or cafe with a view over the water and order a cocktail.
If it does not pop, try other beachfront venues; the exact trigger is still being confirmed.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The official description is the clue: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the glass front of a vehicle showroom and out the other side, the way the classic scene plays. PowerPyx still lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, so the showroom that triggers it has not been confirmed by a full walkthrough yet; the description itself is the best lead available.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a glass front.
Drive a car through it and out the other side.
If it does not pop, try other showrooms; the exact trigger is still being confirmed.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which marks it automatically. Inside, take the luxury watch from the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun from the north-east table, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway, blowing it open with sticky bombs bought at an Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns later and you can go back for what is left, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: During Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2, enter Kingpin Bowling.
Take the luxury watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe contents.
Escape the police; the trophy pops after the escape.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, then Strength. You can only start after Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Work out at a fitness club, always bringing your partner along, because while one character trains the other completes their training too, doubling progress. There are clubs all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership.
Work out with your partner alongside you so both train at once.
Reach maximum strength with both characters.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives, clean escapes and destroying evidence push the Professional side; wounding enemies pushes Hardened; killing pushes Violent; mass killing pushes Psycho; and excessive violence can lock in the permanent Irredeemable profile, which PowerPyx warns against because police shoot on sight more often. Most of the 500 happen passively during robberies and fights on the way to the platinum.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in the settings.
Play normally; robberies and encounters count toward the 500.
Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile from excessive violence.

trophies.guide: No launch-era source confirms how this trophy unlocks, so this guide invents no method. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. KeenGamer and TechNerdiness also list the method as unconfirmed, and DamnModz notes it as the one unlock still not found, with a best lead of robbing the Little Cuba Payday Loans store again as Lucia, alone, after getting the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3. That lead is unverified: do not plan your run around it. Check back after more players report it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: No confirmed method yet.
Community lead (unverified): re-rob the Little Cuba Payday Loans store as Lucia alone after Chapter 3.
Do not treat the lead as confirmed.

trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to come from a UFO questline. The description reads like a reaction to something strange, which fits an encounter with something unexplained in the world. No full walkthrough confirms the trigger yet, so this guide does not present a method as fact: watch for UFO-related stranger content in free-roam and check back as the community pins the questline down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: No confirmed method yet.
Believed to be tied to a UFO encounter questline (PowerPyx).
Explore stranger content in free-roam and check back for confirmation.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No launch-era source confirms how this trophy unlocks, so this guide invents no method. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. KeenGamer agrees the precise method is still being confirmed. The description points at a melee drive-by, knocking people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but the exact vehicle, target and count are not confirmed by any source this guide could verify.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: No confirmed method yet.
Community belief (unverified): melee kicks from a moving motorcycle.
Do not treat the belief as confirmed.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, so you do not need $250,000 at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally while doing the vault line.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans stores for marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 in total to a fence; Yasmani pays best.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. This counts cumulatively, so every weapon, outfit, vehicle upgrade and supply you buy along the way adds up. By the time you have geared up for the robbery and activity trophies, the total is usually most of the way there; top it up with big purchases late in the game if needed.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear, weapons, outfits and upgrades as you play.
Spending counts across all shops, cumulatively.
Top up with a large purchase if the total is short late on.

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garage properties. Garages give you somewhere to store the cars you collect for Randy's wish list and the Scooter Bros registrations, so buy them as you can afford them rather than leaving them all to the end. The purchase total also feeds the Treat Yo Self spending trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Find the eight purchasable garages on the map.
Buy all eight; each one also counts toward Treat Yo Self.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Use the app on cars you own or find, and the registration sticks. It pairs with the vehicle discovery work for Whip It Good: scan a car with WAiNK, then register the ones you keep. Ten registrations is a small target against the 100 vehicles you will discover anyway.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 vehicles through it.
